# Templates by who receives them (decision 379)

- `owner/` — owner emails (O…), My job page designs (P1–P4, P6) and the payment statement wording
- `installer/` — installer emails (I…), the P5 privacy notice page and `portal/` screen designs (M…)
- `electrician/` — electrician emails and screen designs (E…)
- `office/` — office reply samples and `portal/` office screen designs
- `mitti/` — where the Mitti A1–A5 questions live
- `compliance/` — filled official PIESA / PIISA and SWMS samples
- `invoices/` — the final invoice email (O45)
- `drafts/` — wording waiting for Jo's approval

The office Templates page (More › Templates) renders every current item from the live code with TEST sample data;
the files here are the approved designs that code is tested against. Retired designs stay in their folder but are not
listed on the page.
